datasets.name: Official GSI & HPSDMA Field Landslide Inventory (July 2023 Disaster)
datasets.source: Geological Survey of India (GSI) & Himachal Pradesh State Disaster Management Authority (HPSDMA)
datasets.source_reference: GSI Report M4EGG/C/NR/SU-PHP/2023/46620 'Post-Disaster Geotechnical Assessment of Landslides in Kullu Valley July 2023'
datasets.labels: Landslide failure locations (debris flow, rockfall, planar slide)
datasets.relation_to_training_data: Completely excluded from pre-disaster M6 training sets; zero overlap with synthetic slope points.
datasets.limitations: Small sample size (N=20); spatial clustering along NH-3 highway corridor introduces anthropogenic road-cut bias; high-elevation unpopulated ridgelines are underrepresented.

datasets.name: Authoritative Geologically Stable Absence Controls (Upper Beas)
datasets.source: Archaeological Survey of India (ASI) / Geological Survey of India (GSI) / HPSDMA
datasets.source_reference: ASI National Monument Register & GSI Engineering Geology Division Monitored Bedrock Sites
datasets.labels: Absence controls: monitored unfailed bedrock formations (Naggar Castle, Bajaura Temple, etc.)
datasets.timestamps: Centennial historical permanence through July 2023 storm surge
datasets.relation_to_training_data: Independent historical preservation sites, not included in training sets.
datasets.limitations: Limited sample size (N=12); selected on historical architectural and bedrock stability rather than uniform probabilistic random spatial sampling.

datasets.name: Himachal Pradesh Historical Storm-Landslide Event Catalog
datasets.source: GSI / HPSDMA / IMD / Published Literature (Himanshu et al. 2025, Catena)
datasets.source_reference: Catena (2025) DOI: 10.1016/j.catena.2024.108452 / IMD Western Himalayan Severe Weather Reports
datasets.labels: Storm episode trigger classification (5 landslide-triggering storms, 2 control non-trigger storms)

spatial_coordinates.scope: Himachal Pradesh Western Himalayas (Beas, Sutlej, Ravi valleys)

datasets.relation_to_training_data: Macro-level event catalog, not part of model training data.
datasets.limitations: Small event count (N=7 storm episodes); represents regional valley-level aggregates rather than sensor-level slope telemetry.

datasets.name: Upper Beas Field-Verified Landslide Trigger vs Stable Control Dataset
datasets.source: GSI Report M4EGG/C/NR/SU-PHP/2023/46620 / HPSDMA / IMD Automatic Weather Stations
datasets.source_reference: GSI Report M4EGG/C/NR/SU-PHP/2023/46620 combined with IMD AWS precipitation and Copernicus 30m DEM
datasets.labels: Binary trigger outcome: 11 landslide triggers, 11 stable controls under identical July 2023 storm
datasets.relation_to_training_data: Filtered with >500m buffer distance from any historical training points; completely separate 2023 event.
datasets.limitations: CRITICAL LIMITATION: 22 rows represent 22 spatial points sampled from ONE SINGLE meteorological storm episode (July 2023); this does NOT represent 22 independent storms across multiple seasons.

datasets.name: HPSDMA & CWC Upper Beas July 2023 Flood Inundation Ground Points
datasets.source: HPSDMA Post-Disaster Needs Assessment 2023 / Central Water Commission (CWC) / NRSC
datasets.source_reference: HPSDMA PDNA Kullu Report 2023 & CWC Thalout River Gauge High-Water Survey
datasets.labels: Flood inundation observed: 12 inundated active channel sites, 12 unflooded elevated terrace controls

spatial_coordinates.corridor: Upper Beas River Corridor (Manali to Aut Gorge)

datasets.relation_to_training_data: July 2023 event points were not part of M2 hydrological calibration.
datasets.limitations: Small sample size (N=24: 12 positive, 12 negative); measures high-water inundation extents rather than continuous discharge time-series hydrographs.
